## Goal
- Fix all 65 unverified modules in the IVX module registry, deploy to Render, collect live proof evidence, QA and audit end-to-end owner sign-in for certification, then deep QA audit 5 autonomous system claims with honest evidence.

## Constraints & Preferences
- User demands honest, evidence-based certification — no fake/hollow claims
- Every module's `sourceFiles` must point to real files that exist on disk
- Live proof evidence required after deploy (HTTP 200 responses from production endpoints)
- Owner sign-in must be QA'd end-to-end and certified
- Deep QA audit of 5 claims must provide honest PASS/FAIL with real evidence

- `backend/api/ivx-owner-auth.ts` modified with production Supabase fallbacks (commit `b4b71ab8`)
